seoTitle: How to Issue a Partial Refund on eBay (2026)
metaDescription: Step-by-step guide to issuing partial refunds on eBay for damaged items or buyer disputes, including how it affects fees and seller ratings.
intro: Not every buyer issue needs a full return — a partial refund lets sellers resolve damaged items, missing parts, or minor complaints while keeping the sale intact. This guide explains how to issue one through eBay's resolution tools and what it means for your account.

steps.heading: Open the resolution center
steps.body: Go to your Seller Hub, find the order in question, and choose the option to issue a refund rather than process a full return.

steps.heading: Select a refund reason
steps.body: Pick the reason that matches the situation — such as item not as described or buyer dissatisfaction — so the refund is logged correctly.

steps.heading: Enter the partial amount
steps.body: Specify the exact dollar amount you're refunding instead of the full order total, keeping the rest of the transaction as-is.

steps.heading: Track the refund in your dashboard
steps.body: Once submitted, the refund status appears in your Seller Hub so you can confirm it's processed and see how it's reflected in your payout.

steps.heading: Communicate with the buyer directly
steps.body: For sensitive cases, message the buyer to explain the refund before or after issuing it — this often prevents a dispute from escalating.

faq.question: Does a partial refund affect my eBay seller rating?
faq.answer: Handled promptly and communicated well, a partial refund is generally viewed favorably and can help you avoid a negative review or formal case.

faq.question: Are eBay fees adjusted after a partial refund?
faq.answer: eBay typically adjusts final value fees proportionally to the refunded amount, though the adjustment isn't always instant.

faq.question: Can a buyer request a partial refund themselves?
faq.answer: Buyers can message a seller requesting one, but only the seller can actually issue it through the resolution center — eBay doesn't let buyers self-serve a partial refund.

faq.question: Is a partial refund better than accepting a return?
faq.answer: For minor issues, a partial refund saves both parties the cost and hassle of return shipping, which is often preferable for low-value or bulky items.
